wan.notes: 1x GbE minimum. Primary WAN + WAN profile orchestration mandatory. Secondary/backup WAN, PPPoE, GRE, and IPv6 transition mechanisms (MAP-E/T, NAT64, DS-Lite, 464XLAT) are optional.

lan.notes: Port management, link up/down detection, and link speed management are marked Optional in the RDK-B Component List; include if the SKU offers LAN ports.

easyMesh.notes: EasyMesh is not mandatory for this profile; router can run standalone AP mode.

bluetoothIot.notes: Required only if Matter/Zigbee/Thread IoT support is enabled; BLE used for Matter commissioning.

cellular.notes: Marked n/a for this profile in the RDK-B Component List 2026 (WAN Interface Features > Access Technology - Cellular: Qualcomm QMI, MBIM, USB RNDIS, GPS). Cellular access technology is Optional only for GW / GW OpenSync / GW EasyMesh profiles, which use it as one of several WAN access technologies; EthWAN WiFi Router uses Ethernet WAN exclusively.

storageInterface.notes: A/B partition layout recommended to support OTA firmware upgrade HAL.

mediaTuner.notes: DOCSIS, xDSL, GPON/EPON, cellular, and MTA/voice hardware are all marked not applicable for this profile.

diagnostics.notes: Residential HTML/HTTPS portal typically included; UART/debug console recommended for bring-up.
